title: Co-op Super Mario 64 on a Switch

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Super Mario 64, with friends online, on a Nintendo Switch. That's the pitch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: sm64coopdx-switch is Antoine's Switch homebrew port of sm64coopdx. The original project adds online co-op and Lua mod support, and the port brings both to the Switch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He tracks and maintains the Switch build work: a C port from the sm64coopdx codebase, with build scripts that produce a dot nro file you can run on the console.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You supply your own copy of Super Mario 64. The repository holds the port's source and build scripts, so you add your game file and build.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The upstream project is much bigger, around thirteen hundred stars, and this repo is the Switch-specific branch of that work. The README walks through the toolchain, ROM placement and build output.
